entities.name: Abolitionism
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The movement to end slavery (c. 1780–1888), spanning the Atlantic world. From British abolitionists who ended the slave trade in 1807, to American abolitionists like Douglass and Tubman, to the final abolition in Brazil (1888), the movement reshaped concepts of human rights.
